'library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#31333F"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#808495"),
      text = element_text(colour = "#31333F"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E6E9EF"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# Kalender-Heatmap der Monatsrenditen
p <- dataset |>
  mutate(datum = as.Date(substr(as.character(Datum), 1, 10))) |>
  arrange(datum) |>
  mutate(
    rendite = Index / lag(Index) - 1,
    jahr = as.integer(format(datum, "%Y")),
    monat = factor(format(datum, "%m"), labels = month.abb)
  ) |>
  filter(jahr >= max(jahr) - 29) |>
  drop_na(rendite) |>
  ggplot(aes(monat, jahr, fill = rendite)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#FF2B2B",
    mid = "#F0F2F6",
    high = "#0068C9",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),
    oob = scales::squish,
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(1990, 2030, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Kalender-Heatmap: Monatsrenditen",
    subtitle = "Letzte 30 Jahre, Farbskala bei \u00b110 % gekappt",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))

print(p)
'
